objective: Port remaining dav1d C89 files into stb_avif.h to fix the internal AV1 decoder.

actions: Ported itx_1d_c89.c + itx_tmpl_c89.c: fixed-point integer transforms (DCT/ADST/FLIPADST/Identity) integrated
history.outcome: Fixed-point integer transforms integrated from dav1d.

actions: Updated stb_av1_get_dequant() to use bit_depth index
history.outcome: Proper dequant tables from dav1d integrated.

actions: Added AV1-spec dequant shift: dq_shift = imax(0, lw+lh-2) per transform size
Added inverse transform shift: inv_shift = imin(lw,1)+imin(lh,1) after 2D transform
Debugged MSAC initialization, OBU parsing, coefficient EOB values
history.outcome: Dequant and transform shifts per AV1 spec. All pipeline math matches dav1d formulas.

actions: Fixed CDF count entries: zeroed after memcpy (was overwritten with ICDF values)
Debugged V plane (chroma): confirmed V plane IS written but with wrong values
Instrumented plane pointer check: U and V are separate buffers
history.outcome: All identified CDF initialization bugs fixed. PSNR unchanged at ~10.5dB. The root cause is deeper — likely in the MSAC decode_symbol implementation or the CDF table data itself.
